title: Both Orders Agree: measure the gap before training Scion

strictLayeredEvaluation.note: Local proof reconstructs the exact reversed workbook, verifies both sealed envelopes and four local key round trips, reproduces 46 admitted rows without review plaintext, and checks the complete software release. It proves a paid-reference advantage in this source-bound atom packet, not a trained-adapter, held-out-course, human, device, or production win.

claims.summary: The 100-case B/A workbook reconstructs only from the exact packet and sealed first-order public identity, then requires GPT-5.6-Luna/max on Codex CLI 0.144.2 in a distinct session.
Two independently sealed same-identity readings agree on 76 of 100 cases: 46 stable winners and 30 stable ties, with 24 order-sensitive cases quarantined.
All 46 stable score-qualified winners favor GPT-5.4-mini over captured Scion base, distributed 10/6/19/11 across the four training domains.
Winner admission can use concrete defects already recorded on the losing scorecard when the duplicate preference-level defect array is empty, without changing judgment content.
The research corpus contains 46 of 100 required same-identity rows; no quality adapter is trained, active, held-out tested, or promoted.
